title: ChatGPT Atlas Browser Stops Service on August 9th, Users Need to Export Bookmarks Within 10 Days

content_html:
OpenAI has buried its first browser itself. ChatGPT Atlas will officially stop service on August 9, after which it will no longer push feature updates or fix security vulnerabilities. From its launch on macOS on October 21, 2025, the product has only survived for less than ten months.

The most embarrassing part is that Atlas data will not automatically flow into the new version of ChatGPT. To keep past bookmarks and history records, users have to manually export the data into HTML files and then manually import them into other browsers like Chrome. Worse still, Atlas currently cannot export Cookies, which means users have to log in again to all websites after migration, and there's no escaping the tedious task of re-entering account passwords.

OpenAI made its statement very straightforward in the announcement: after August 9, Atlas will most likely not be able to open any web pages. Moreover, a browser that is no longer maintained will expose security vulnerabilities over time, continuing to use it is like playing with cybersecurity. Therefore, they explicitly advised users not to linger, but to switch early.

content_html_zh:
OpenAI 已经埋葬了它的第一个浏览器。 ChatGPT Atlas将于8月9日正式停止服务，之后将不再推送功能更新或修复安全漏洞。 从2025年10月21日在macOS上推出以来，该产品仅存活了不到十个月。

最尴尬的是Atlas数据不会自动流入新版本的ChatGPT。 为了保留过去的书签和历史记录，用户必须手动将数据导出到 HTML 文件中，然后手动将其导入到 Chrome 等其他浏览器中。 更糟糕的是，Atlas目前无法导出Cookie，这意味着用户在迁移后必须重新登录所有网站，并且免不了重新输入帐户密码的繁琐任务。

OpenAI在公告中的声明非常直白：8月9日之后，Atlas很可能无法打开任何网页。 此外，不再维护的浏览器随着时间的推移会暴露安全漏洞，继续使用它就像玩网络安全一样。 因此，他们明确建议用户不要徘徊，而是尽早切换。
